  - The footer still says "prelaunch waitlist".
  - The 24-pack never shows that it's cheaper per can.

  https://www.upwork.com/jobs/~022111463090578451797
- **Australian sales job:** $95/hr, 18 Connects. I asked them for the store link and one of their ads. https://www.upwork.com/jobs/~022111459459708784225
- **Veriheal CRO Lead trial:** $95/hr, 20 Connects. I wrote to Grant, the contact named in their reviews, with 2 fixes from their Louisiana page and said up front that our rate is above theirs. One risk: they've already made someone an offer. https://www.upwork.com/jobs/~022111115492959639925
- **233 Connects left.**

The records are saved in the repo. Saving them broke an automatic check because I'd stored summaries instead of the letters as sent. I fixed it and all checks pass now.

**Next:** I check for replies tomorrow morning, and any reply becomes a ticket on the Acquisition board. Your call is still open: should the scan run every 2 hours so we apply within the first hour of a job going up?
